items.title: 21.13 Role of salt and density in ocean circulation (samandar ki circulation mein namak aur density ka kirdar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of salt and density in ocean circulation (PDF 182).

blocks.title: Tidbit! (Dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Dead Sea (Bahr-e-Murdar) itna namkeen hai ke log is mein baghair mehnat ke tairte rehte hain; namak zyada hone ki wajah se is ke pani ki density bohat zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: Polar areas mein barf bante hue samandar ka pani zyada namkeen ho jata hai. Yeh ocean circulation par kya asar karta hai, aur kaun sa process chalata hai?
blocks.explanation: Sea ice bante waqt zyada tar namak pani mein peeche chhor deti hai, is liye baqi pani thanda aur namkeen, yani zyada dense ho jata hai. Yeh pani doob jata hai aur thermohaline circulation (global conveyor belt) ka gehra hissa chalata hai.

blocks.text: Samandar ke pani mein bohat si cheezen ghuli hoti hain, jin mein sab se zyada namak hai. Samandar ke pani mein namak ki amount (miqdar) ko salinity (namkeenpan) kehte hain. Jab pani mein namak zyada ho to woh bhari, yani zyada dense ho jata hai. Wajah yeh hai ke ghula hua namak pani ki mass to barhata hai lekin us ka volume (jagah) khaas nahi barhata. Is liye zyada salinity ka matlab zyada density hai.

Samandar mein pani ke alag alag hisson (water masses) ki density ka farq ocean circulation chalane wali aham forces (taqaton) mein se hai, khaas taur par gehre pani mein. Density ka yeh farq zyada tar temperature aur salinity ke farq se paida hota hai. Thanda pani garam pani se zyada dense hai, aur namkeen pani kam namkeen pani se zyada dense hai. Jab surface ka pani zyada thanda aur namkeen ho jaye (aksar evaporation, yani bhaap ban kar urne, ya sea ice banne se), to woh dense ho kar gehri layers mein doob jata hai. Doobta hua dense pani doosre pani ko hata deta hai, jis se dheemi lekin bohat bare paimane ki currents banti hain jo duniya ke tamam samandaron mein ghoomti hain. Yeh gehri circulation heat (garmi) aur gases (jaise oxygen aur carbon dioxide) ko poori duniya mein le jati hai. Yeh surface aur gehre pani ko jorti hai aur zameen ka climate control mein rakhne mein bohat aham kirdar ada karti hai.

items: Salinity: pani mein namak ki amount; zyada namak, zyada density.
Thanda aur namkeen pani doobta hai; density ka farq gehri ocean circulation chalata hai jo heat aur gases le jati hai.
